scope: Diagnosis only, after the installed Id default-lookup fact optimization. No further runtime/application changes. Fresh bootstrap using installed authored/native owners; stdlib and stacklessControl loaded. Probe blocks use normal Codegen eval. A native driver invokes each prepared block, so timings include block invocation/return but not an authored measurement loop. Three warmups, three timed samples, explicit GC outside samples and automatic GC on inside. Separate one-invocation allocation census with automatic GC off. Instrumented Id dispatch census is separate from uninstrumented timing. Counts are protocol messages, not CPU percentages.
